cases.name: plain-table
cases.desc: Ordinary table, nothing fenced, no framing

cases.name: text-necessary
cases.desc: Text around a value holding a control byte: canonical

cases.name: text-escaped-six
cases.desc: DLE before one of the six inside text: canonical

cases.name: text-gratuitous
cases.desc: Text around a value that could be plain: not canonical

cases.name: text-empty
cases.desc: Empty text: the empty string is written as nothing

cases.name: layout-space
cases.desc: Whitespace touching a code is layout: legal, not canonical

cases.name: layout-newline
cases.desc: Line breaks between codes are layout

cases.name: keyed-sorted
cases.desc: Keyed record with sorted unique keys

cases.name: keyed-unsorted
cases.desc: Keys out of bytewise order: not canonical

cases.name: keyed-duplicate
cases.desc: Duplicate key: not canonical

cases.name: trailing-eot
cases.desc: EOT is framing: not part of a canonical document unit

cases.name: etb-framing
cases.desc: ETB is framing: not part of a canonical document unit

cases.name: syn-heading
cases.desc: SYN and the heading are framing: not part of a canonical document unit

cases.name: comment
cases.desc: A comment is outside the hash: not part of a canonical unit

cases.name: raw-lf-in-plain
cases.desc: LF inside a plain value: malformed

cases.name: dle-mid-value
cases.desc: DLE in the middle of a plain value: malformed

cases.name: dle-before-plain-in-text
cases.desc: DLE before a byte that is not one of the six: malformed

cases.name: dangling-dle
cases.desc: DLE at end of input: malformed

cases.name: unassigned-code
cases.desc: Bare unassigned control byte: malformed

cases.name: so-byte
cases.desc: SO is permanently unassigned

cases.name: dle-before-plain
cases.desc: DLE outside text must be followed by a code: malformed

cases.name: empty-level
cases.desc: DLE CAN is the empty level: canonical

cases.name: text-reference
cases.desc: A group reference written as text: not canonical

cases.name: mixed-record
cases.desc: A record is positional or keyed, never mixed
